records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were $144.1 million for the three months ended September 30, 2023 compared to $166.1 million in the three months ended September 30, 2022, a decrease of $22.0, or 13.2%.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in sales in the three months ended September 30, 2023 was due to a decrease in preseason orders shipped during the quarter compared to the prior year, as well as lower customer reorder activity, somewhat offset by pricing actions implemented to offset inflation.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were $433.9 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2023 compared to $456.3 million in the nine months ended September 30, 2022, a decrease of $22.4 million, or 4.9%.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in sales in the nine months ended September 30, 2023 was primarily due to low snowfall in our core markets leading to lower volumes in 2023, somewhat offset by pricing actions implemented to offset inflation.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net cash used in operating activities decreased $10.3 million from the nine months ended September 30, 2022 to the nine months ended September 30, 2023.
